summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) batching ten London Stock Exchange 'Transaction in Own Shares' notices dated 5-16 October 2026. Each reports daily open-market buybacks of ordinary shares through Goldman Sachs International under the authority granted at the 8 May 2025 AGM, executed pursuant to broker instructions issued 17 February 2026. Daily volumes were roughly 1,000 shares, with average prices near $160-161 and a range of about $159.50-162.70; purchased shares are to be cancelled, and issued share capital declined to 147,159,314 excluding 5,431,782 treasury shares. Watch for execution pace versus the announced programme size and any acceleration signals.
